title: Brews & Spirits Expo 2026
location: KTPO Convention Centre, Whitefield, Bengaluru, India
summary: Seventh edition of India's alcobev trade show: brand owners, brewers, winemakers, distillers, equipment makers and technology providers, with a conference and awards programme alongside the floor. The single densest gathering of Indian beverage decision makers in the calendar.

title: BrauBeviale 2026
location: Nuremberg, Germany
summary: Europe's working trade fair for beverage production: raw materials, technology, logistics and marketing. Historically one of the highest-yield surfaces for finding brewing technology vendors, since the exhibitor list is published in full.

title: Master Brewers Conference 2026
organiser: Master Brewers Association of the Americas
location: Virginia Beach Convention Center, Virginia, United States
summary: The technical brewing conference: sessions, workshops and an exhibit hall aimed at production brewers rather than marketers. A good read on where automation and process-control tools are actually landing on the brewhouse floor.

title: Unified Wine & Grape Symposium 2027
organiser: ASEV and California Association of Winegrape Growers
location: SAFE Credit Union Convention Center, Sacramento, California, United States
summary: The largest wine industry trade show and technical conference in the Americas, held each January, covering viticulture, winemaking and increasingly the data and sensing side of both.

title: Craft Brewers Conference & BrewExpo America 2026
location: Pennsylvania Convention Center, Philadelphia, United States
summary: The US craft brewing industry's main annual gathering, shortened to three days for the 2026 edition. Already past for this year; listed so the cycle is visible when planning the next one.

title: Anuga FoodTec 2027
location: Cologne, Germany
summary: Food and beverage process technology fair covering automation, filling, packaging and digitalisation. Relevant because the brewery automation vendors exhibit here under a food-and-beverage banner rather than a brewing one.

title: IBD events and courses
location: United Kingdom and online
summary: Rolling programme of technical events, courses and webinars for brewing and distilling. Mixed in-person and online, which makes it one of the few reliably reachable technical programmes from outside the UK.

title: drinktec 2028
location: Munich, Germany
summary: The world's largest beverage and liquid food technology fair, held every few years; the 2025 edition drew participants from 164 countries. Sources disagree on whether the next edition is 2028 or 2029, so no dates are recorded here until the organiser confirms.

title: How AI Is Transforming Breweries: Craft Beer School
location: Online
summary: Ankur Napa session for Craft Beer School on where AI actually lands in a working brewery, and where it does not. Recorded and freely watchable.

title: The Modern Brewer Podcast, Ep 24: AI in Brewing
location: Online
summary: Ankur Napa on what AI is for a brewer, which tools and systems it can realistically replace, real deployments, and the blunt question of whether it replaces brewers.

title: Bridging the Gap Between Artificial Intelligence and Brewing
location: Online
summary: Ankur Napa talk for Brewer World making the case that brewing domain knowledge is what makes brewing data useful, delivered from the position of having done both jobs.

title: ASBC & CIBD 2026 Global Brewing and Distilling Congress
organiser: American Society of Brewing Chemists and Chartered Institute of Brewers and Distillers
location: Seattle, Washington, United States
summary: First joint congress of ASBC and CIBD, themed Global Brewing and Distilling Innovation: Shaping the Future Together, spanning beer, distilled spirits and wine. The two bodies bring roughly 4000 technical members across 90 and 40 countries respectively, which makes this the densest technical gathering of the year for fermentation science.

title: Vine to Mind Symposium 2026
organiser: Harvard Data Science Initiative and UC Davis
location: UC Davis and Napa Valley, California, United States
summary: The clearest wine-meets-data-science programme running, held on the 50th anniversary of the Judgment of Paris. Named AI sessions include Tomorrow's Grapevines: AI-Powered Genomics and Breeding, Current State and Moonshots: AI from Vineyard to End Consumer, Data Science Tools for the Future of Wine, and a conversation on AI and Wine: Excitements and Cautionary Tales.

title: Brew What Sells with AI: An Evidence Engine for Craft Breweries
organiser: drinktec India (Messe Munchen India and YONTEX), Brewers Conference and Networking, 3rd Edition
location: Biergarten, Koramangala, Bengaluru, India
summary: Free master class at the 3rd edition Brewers Conference and Networking, organised by drinktec India, on turning years of POS data into brewing decisions: which beers sell best by day, time and season, and building a daily brewing calculator for production planning. The argument is that most breweries already generate the sales data and almost none of them feed it back into what goes in the tank. Free to attend, registration by form, 5 PM onwards.

title: Technical Workshop on Methods of Recipe Development: Traditional and AI Powered
organiser: VLB Berlin and iWORT, at Brews & Spirits Expo 5th edition
location: KTPO Convention Centre, Whitefield, Bengaluru, India
summary: Half-day workshop, 1130 to 1330, running recipe development from both ends: sensory profiling and consumer testing, malt and hop selection, hands-on calculation of malt and hop quantities for a target bitterness and colour, and then a block on where AI helps optimise those ingredient calculations for consistency. Delivered jointly by VLB Berlin and iWORT at the fifth Brews & Spirits Expo. The programme is one of the few that puts the traditional method and the AI-assisted one side by side rather than selling one against the other.

title: Smart Manufacturing Food & Beverage Europe 2026
location: Copthorne Tara Hotel, Kensington, London, United Kingdom
summary: A one-day conference on AI, data analytics, industrial IoT and digital twins for food and beverage plants. One of the few events in the calendar that is about the technology itself rather than the drinks.

title: SIMEI 2026
location: Fiera Milano, Rho, Milan, Italy
summary: The international trade fair for winemaking and bottling technology: cellar equipment, filling lines and quality-control tools, with a digital platform added this edition.

title: Vinitech-Sifel 2026
location: Bordeaux Exhibition Centre, Bordeaux, France
summary: The big vineyard and winery equipment show, now in its 25th edition, with a start-up village aimed at the climate, cost and digital pressures on wine producers.

title: Wine Paris & Vinexpo Paris 2027
location: Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, Paris, France
summary: France's main wine and spirits trade show, where producers meet importers and distributors from across the world.

title: Beer&Food Attraction and BBTech Expo 2027
location: Rimini Expo Centre, Rimini, Italy
summary: Italy's beer and beverage trade show. BBTech Expo is its technology hall: processing, fermentation, filling and packaging equipment.

title: ProWein 2027
location: Messe Düsseldorf, Düsseldorf, Germany
summary: The world's largest trade fair for wine and spirits, bringing producers, importers and retailers together, with a growing set of traceability and e-commerce exhibitors.

title: BeerX UK 2027
organiser: Society of Independent Brewers and Associates (SIBA)
location: Exhibition Centre Liverpool, Liverpool, United Kingdom
summary: The UK's biggest independent brewing trade event: an exhibition, seminars and SIBA's annual meeting. A fair read on what UK craft brewers are actually buying.

title: WSWA Access LIVE 2027
location: Gaylord Texan Resort & Convention Center, Dallas, Texas, United States
summary: The US wine and spirits wholesale channel's main business event, covering distribution, compliance and route-to-market technology. The commercial side of drinks, not production.

title: Oregon Wine Symposium 2027
location: Oregon Convention Center, Portland, Oregon, United States
summary: Oregon's wine industry conference and trade show, mixing viticulture science, business sessions and vineyard technology.

title: ACSA Convention & Expo 2027
location: Chicago, Illinois, United States
summary: The annual convention and expo for US craft distillers, covering production, compliance and the tools small distilleries run on.

title: Craft Brewers Conference & BrewExpo America 2027
location: Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center, San Antonio, Texas, United States
summary: The largest US craft brewing conference and trade show, co-located with CiderCon this year. Where brewery software, automation and quality tools tend to launch.

title: ForBeer, ForVini, ForDestila and ForÁgua 2027
location: Centro de Convenções Circuito das Águas, Serra Negra, São Paulo, Brazil
summary: A combined Brazilian trade fair for beer, wine, spirits and water production, focused on bottling, packaging and processing equipment.

title: EXPO PACK Guadalajara 2027
location: Expo Guadalajara, Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico
summary: Latin America's largest packaging and processing show, with a strong beverage manufacturing presence.

title: Fispal Tecnologia 2027
location: São Paulo Expo, São Paulo, Brazil
summary: South America's largest food and beverage technology fair: automation, processing and packaging for plants across the region.

title: IFT FIRST 2027
location: McCormick Place, Chicago, Illinois, United States
summary: A large US food and beverage science expo with its own AI and formulation-technology programme, used by drinks makers to scout ingredients, sensors and product-development tools.

title: ADI Craft Spirits Conference & Expo 2027
location: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States
summary: The American Distilling Institute's annual conference and vendor expo for craft distillers: production equipment, quality control and business tools.

title: PACK EXPO Las Vegas 2027
location: Las Vegas Convention Center, Las Vegas, Nevada, United States
summary: One of the largest US packaging and processing shows, with a food and beverage processing zone covering automation, robotics and quality systems for bottling lines.

title: Propak East Africa 2027
location: Sarit Expo Centre, Nairobi, Kenya
summary: East Africa's main packaging and processing exhibition, including beverage processing and bottling lines for the region's breweries and bottlers.

title: agrofood Nigeria 2027
location: Landmark Centre, Lagos, Nigeria
summary: West Africa's agrofood trade show, with a beverage-technology segment covering processing, bottling and packaging. A route into Nigeria's large brewing base.

title: Fi Africa & ProPak MENA 2027
location: Egypt International Exhibition Center, Cairo, Egypt
summary: The region's largest food and beverage ingredients and processing show, alongside ProPak MENA's packaging and manufacturing technology exhibition.

title: Anuga Select South Africa 2027
location: Cape Town International Convention Centre, Cape Town, South Africa
summary: Southern Africa's food and beverage trade event, rebranded under Anuga for 2027, bringing international processing and packaging suppliers into the South African market.

title: China Brew China Beverage 2026
location: Shanghai New International Expo Centre, Shanghai, China
summary: China's largest brewing and beverage processing technology exhibition, part of the drinktec network: equipment, automation and process control for beer and soft drinks.

title: drinktec India 2026
location: Bombay Exhibition Centre, Mumbai, India
summary: India's trade fair for beverage and liquid food technology: process automation, bottling and packaging. The production side of Indian drinks, where Brews & Spirits Expo is the brand side.

title: Brew Asia 2026
location: The Adora Centre, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
summary: Asia's conference and trade fair for craft and independent brewing, focused on scaling a brewery technically and commercially.

title: Gulfood Manufacturing 2026
location: Dubai World Trade Centre, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
summary: The Middle East's largest food and beverage manufacturing show: bottling, packaging, automation and traceability.

title: Hong Kong International Wine & Spirits Fair 2026
location: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, Wan Chai, Hong Kong
summary: One of Asia's largest wine, spirits and beer trade fairs, connecting producers with Asian importers and distributors.

title: ProWine Shanghai 2026
location: Shanghai New International Expo Centre, Shanghai, China
summary: China's main wine and spirits trade fair under the ProWein brand, bringing global producers to Chinese buyers.

title: Interwine & Spirits Asia 2026
location: Canton Fair Complex, Pazhou, Guangzhou, China
summary: A large Chinese wine and spirits exhibition spanning imported wine, baijiu, whisky and global spirits.

title: Gulfood 2027
location: Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai Exhibition Centre, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
summary: The world's largest annual food and beverage trade show, with beverage and hospitality technology zones alongside the main halls.

title: Vinexpo Asia 2027
location: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, Hong Kong
summary: Vinexposium's Asian wine and spirits trade fair, an annual Hong Kong fixture from 2027.

title: Grainstock 2026: Fields + Ferment
location: Whitton Malthouse, Whitton, New South Wales, Australia
summary: A grain-to-glass symposium and trade show linking growers, maltsters, brewers and distillers, with a day touring crop trials and grain facilities. Relevant to traceability and supply-chain data behind the malt.

title: 39th CIBD Asia Pacific Convention
organiser: Chartered Institute of Brewers and Distillers, Asia Pacific Section
location: Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia
summary: The technical convention for brewers and distillers across Asia Pacific, with tours on the first and last days and three days of papers between them.

title: Institute of Masters of Wine Symposium 2027
organiser: Institute of Masters of Wine, with Wine Australia
location: Adelaide Convention Centre, Adelaide, South Australia, Australia
summary: The Institute of Masters of Wine's four-day global symposium, held in Adelaide this time: tastings, presentations and debate on the issues facing the wine trade.

title: Foodtech Packtech 2027
location: Auckland Showgrounds, Auckland, New Zealand
summary: New Zealand's largest food and packaging technology exhibition, covering processing and packaging lines for brewers, distillers and winemakers among others.
